facts.fact: Martech is defined as the array of software platforms and tools marketers and marketing operations teams use to plan, execute, manage, and measure their marketing campaigns.
facts.quote: Martech refers to the array of software platforms and tools that marketers and marketing operations teams use to plan, execute, manage, and measure their marketing campaigns.
